whenToUse: Page, form and dialog actions in primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link weights
Icon only controls and sign in rows, such as close, search, copy, menu or theme switches and provider logos
Actions that report state or carry extras, such as a spinner, a saved check, a count or a shortcut

whenNotToUse.when: Several related actions joined edge to edge as one segmented control
A control that stays pressed on or off, such as bold in an editor toolbar
An action attached inside a text field, such as a search submit or a clear

agentNotes: The base twin `Button` defaults to `type` button, so pass `type` submit inside a form; the radix twin renders a plain `button` that submits by default
A link needs its anchor passed through `render` with `nativeButton` false on the base twin, or wrapped with `asChild` on the radix twin
Set `data-icon` to inline-start or inline-end on a leading or trailing icon so the text sizes trim the padding on that side
